text:
deploy-bot: nightly deploy complete: `edge-service` v2026.03.21 (build-985) -> started gradual rollout (3%) to eu1, us-west. release notes URL: https://releases.redwood/2026.03.21

emma: seeing a p95 bump on the synth in eu1 after the first wave. tagging @morgan @raj to eyeball. :eyes:

morgan: how big a bump?

emma: p95 for embed-route-synth jumped from ~120ms -> ~380ms. error rate flat. smoke-bot reports increased KV miss rate and more prefix cache cold reads.

raj: can you paste the smoke-bot output?

smoke-bot: ```
[6212345742] synth-run eu1 embed-route-synth: p50=72ms p95=381ms errors=0.4% kv_miss_rate=18% prefill_progress=42%
[6212345760] warmup: prefix-prefill throughput 42% target 100% ETA ~18m
```

carla: that looks like a kv warmup issue — if prefill is at 42% and we routed more traffic into the new variant, p95 will spike until prefill finishes. how long since rollout started?

emma: ~6m. prefill_progress per deploy-metrics is stuck ~40-45% across warmup workers.

morgan: recommended immediate action? pause rollout for eu1 and pin to previous version until we confirm prefill behavior. Alternatively we could throttle new-variant traffic in eu1, but pause is safest.

raj: +1 on pausing. If we keep going we risk higher client-observed latencies. We can also consider temporarily increasing prefill worker count for eu1 and re-run the synth with a longer warmup window.

emma: ok I'll initiate pause and create a rollback candidate. filing quick note in release docs.

emma: @deploy-bot, please halt rollout in eu1 and pin to v2026.03.20 for stability.

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Pausing rollout for region=eu1 and pinning to previous stable tag v2026.03.20. Current rollout: eu1=rolled back, us-west=3%. Canary traffic unchanged.

carla: plan for next steps: 1) increase prefill workers in eu1 by +50% for the next build, 2) re-run synth after warmup for 15m, 3) collect kv.prefill and prefix-hit-rate metrics and compare to baseline. I'll open a quick ticket.

smoke-bot: Scheduled re-run at +15m: will post fresh p50/p95 and kv_miss snapshots.

raj: good. If re-run looks clean, we can re-rollout with a staggered schedule and lower initial traffic. If not, keep pin and escalate to infra for deeper KV investigation.

morgan: thanks all. Logging this thread in the release notes as a "hold - eu1 prefix cache warmup" and assigning follow-ups. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:

emma: filing the post-deploy issue now: https://issues.redwood/PD-1829 (summary + logs). I'll update once smoke-bot posts the 15m re-run.

smoke-bot: 15m re-run queued. will notify.
